title: The Hermetick Romance, or, The Chymical Wedding
author: Johann Valentin Andreae
description: Ezechiel Foxcroft’s early English translation of a visionary tale associated with the Rosicrucian tradition follows Christian Rosencreutz to a symbolic wedding.
editionNote: 1690 edition. London. Edition credit: Ezechiel Foxcroft.
rights: Public-domain historical edition. Source credit and notices are retained.
